title: Undergraduate Admissions Eligibility
text: For admission into BS Computer Science and BS Software Engineering, candidate must possess minimum 50% marks in Intermediate (F.Sc Pre-Engineering or ICS with Mathematics and Physics) or equivalent from a recognized board.
spoken_text: For admission into Bachelor of Science Computer Science and Bachelor of Science Software Engineering, candidate must possess minimum 50% marks in Intermediate Faculty of Science Pre-Engineering or ICS with Mathematics and Physics or equivalent from a recognized board.

title: Engineering Admissions Eligibility & Entry Test
text: For B.Sc Electrical Engineering, candidates must have passed F.Sc Pre-Engineering with minimum 60% marks and must have appeared in the centralized ETEA or University entrance test as per PEC regulations.
spoken_text: For Bachelor of Science Electrical Engineering, candidates must have passed Faculty of Science Pre-Engineering with minimum 60% marks and must have appeared in the centralized Educational Testing and Evaluation Agency or University entrance test as per Pakistan Engineering Council regulations.

title: Allied Health Sciences Eligibility
text: Admission in Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) and BS Medical Laboratory Technology (MLT) requires minimum 50% marks in F.Sc Pre-Medical. Merit is determined based on Matric and F.Sc marks.
spoken_text: Admission in Doctor of Physical Therapy Doctor of Physical Therapy and Bachelor of Science Medical Laboratory Technology Medical Laboratory Technology requires minimum 50% marks in Faculty of Science Pre-Medical. Merit is determined based on Matric and Faculty of Science marks.

title: Postgraduate MS / M.Phil Admissions
text: For admission to MS and M.Phil programs, candidate must have completed 16 years of education (BS or Master degree) with at least 2.5 CGPA out of 4.0 or 50% marks in annual system, along with passing the GAT General or USTB departmental test with 50% score.
spoken_text: For admission to Master of Science and Master of Philosophy programs, candidate must have completed 16 years of education Bachelor of Science or Master degree with at least 2.5 Cumulative Grade Point Average out of 4.0 or 50% marks in annual system, along with passing the Graduate Assessment Test General or University of Science and Technology Bannu departmental test with 50% score.

metadata.test: GAT General or USTB Test (50% marks)

title: PhD Admissions Criteria
text: For PhD programs, 18 years of education (MS or M.Phil degree) in the relevant field is required with minimum CGPA 3.0 out of 4.0, plus passing GAT Subject or USTB departmental subject test with at least 60% marks.
spoken_text: For Doctor of Philosophy programs, 18 years of education Master of Science or Master of Philosophy degree in the relevant field is required with minimum Cumulative Grade Point Average 3.0 out of 4.0, plus passing Graduate Assessment Test Subject or University of Science and Technology Bannu departmental subject test with at least 60% marks.

title: Application Process & Processing Fee
text: Candidates must apply online through the official UST Bannu admission portal at ustb.edu.pk. The admission processing fee is 1,000 Pakistani Rupees payable at any authorized branch of Habib Bank Limited or National Bank of Pakistan using the generated challan.
spoken_text: Candidates must apply online through the official UST Bannu admission portal at ustb.edu.pk. The admission processing fee is 1,000 Pakistani Rupees payable at any authorized branch of Habib Bank Limited or National Bank of Pakistan using the generated challan.

title: Quota Seats & Reserved Categories
text: UST Bannu reserves seats for erstwhile FATA (tribal districts), Balochistan, sports candidates, disabled students, and university employee wards. Relevant domicile and certificates must be attached during application submission.
spoken_text: UST Bannu reserves seats for erstwhile FATA tribal districts , Balochistan, sports candidates, disabled students, and university employee wards. Relevant domicile and certificates must be attached during application submission.

title: Home - UST Bannu
text: I am so delighted to join University of Science and Technology Bannu (USTB) as a Vice Chancellor for the greater cause of building a platform for providing higher education in yet another under-privileged area of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, especially in the face of reality that it is the first university established in this region (after Gomal University) for the youth of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. The university is in the early stages of development and after my humble efforts for the development of University of Swat, Peshawar and FATA University, I am looking forward to a very productive and positive contribution to the development of USTB.

The university is in the early stages of development and after my humble efforts for the development of University of Swat, Peshawar and FATA University, I am looking forward to a very productive and positive contribution to the development of University of Science and Technology Bannu.

title: Home - UST Bannu
text: Bannu has been a historical city with rich cultural background and has produced notable people with significant contribution to the national development in different fields including higher education. As we all know this region has been suffering (for decades) due to its proximity with Afghanistan and some other factors, which affected the process of development to a great extent. Now there is a strong need to go for damage reversal.

title: Home - UST Bannu
text: My passion for “Transformation through education and training” is the driving force behind my option of choosing USTB for my services. Allah willing, together with my team and relevant people from the larger community, I am fully motivated to bring in positive change in the lives of people of the area through higher education, believing in providing educational facilities at the doorstep of common people. I have always talked very highly of the people of the area as Pakhtuns’ psyche has been the focus of my research. It is so heartening to come and lead this major university in Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa and efforts are on for its development as part of the development initiative taken by the Government in the larger interest of the public. These efforts will make the life of people easy in this part of our beloved country and in the suffering of people will be ultimately lessened.
